name: FieldCraft React Form Engine
free_limit: MIT-licensed local TypeScript form engine with React renderer, schema-based multi-step forms, conditional validation, draft persistence, and optional submission adapters; no software subscription or provider-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: A developer library, not a hosted form collection service or visual form builder. Requires a React application and your own submission backend/storage; hosting, databases and third-party integrations may cost money. Maintainer notes irregular releases and known gaps.
